description:
*Up for auction is a unique lot of two vintage gold charms featuring distinctive institutional and fraternal designs:
Smithsonian Sunburst Charm: Crafted with an arched sunburst motif over a rectangular base marked "Smithsonian". It features a small accent stone set in the lower section (unverified, likely a small diamond or crystal). The reverse is stamped "14K L". Measures approximately 1 inch long by 0.5 inches wide.
The sunburst design on the Smithsonian charm represents the official seal and iconic logo of the Smithsonian Institution. The "sunburst" or "starburst" motif has long been the primary symbol of the Smithsonian. It was formally adapted as the institution's official logo to represent the "increase and diffusion of knowledge", symbolizing light, discovery, and enlightenment.
1947 Job’s Daughters (IJD) Fratertral Honor Key Charm: A vintage 1947 Masonic-affiliated Job’s Daughters key charm featuring a diamond-shaped black enamel center with compass directions (N, S, E, W) and the Greek letters. The back is hand-engraved with "E", initials "I.J.D.", and the class year "'47". Measures approximately 1.25 inches long by 0.5 inches wide. It is unmarked for gold.
IJD stands for International Order of Job's Daughters (a Masonic-affiliated youth organization for young women). The compass points (N, S, E, W) represent the officer positions/directions, while the center displays the Greek letters (Sigma Gamma Epsilon), standing for the motto “Service, Grace, and Excellence” or the organization's emblem. The triangles represent the three Daughters of Job.
Both pieces are in very good vintage condition with minor surface wear appropriate for their age.
Please review all photos carefully for detail.

description:
Mixed Brands
Smoking Pipe Collection with Carousel Rack and Humidor Jar
Vintage, Mixed Materials including Briar, Metal, and Glass
This comprehensive tobacco enthusiast's lot includes seven varied smoking pipes and a classic wooden carousel-style storage rack. The collection showcases a diverse range of pipe-making traditions, from the industrial aesthetic of the metal-stemmed Viking pipe to rustic, hand-carved artisan pieces and a highly detailed figural bowl featuring a carved bearded head. The centerpiece is a tiered wooden carousel that holds up to 12 pipes and features a central glass humidor jar for tobacco preservation.
Viking Metal Stem Pipe: Features a chrome-finished cooling stem and a removable bowl for cleaning
Figural Carved Pipe: Intricately detailed bowl depicting a bearded man, likely meerschaum or high-density composite
Hand-Carved Artisan Pipes: Two rustic faceted wood pipes, one bearing the hand-carved initials "RKB" on the underside
Wooden Carousel Rack: Two-tier walnut-toned wood construction with a ribbed glass humidor jar and matching wooden lid
Dimensions: Carousel rack measures approximately 7" in diameter and 6.5" in height to the lid top
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall. All pipes show evidence of previous use with carbon buildup inside the bowls and light tooth chatter or oxidation on some stems. The wooden carousel shows minor surface scuffing and finish wear consistent with age. The glass humidor jar is free of chips or cracks. The Viking metal stem shows light surface pitting typical of vintage chrome-plated components.

description:
Esterbrook
Fountain Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set - Red Jewel Tone
Vintage, Mid-20th Century, 2 Pieces plus Box
This vintage Esterbrook writing set showcases the mid-century design of the iconic Camden, New Jersey manufacturer. Founded in 1858, Esterbrook was a leader in American stationery, legendary for its interchangeable nib system and reliable lever-fill mechanisms. This matched pair features a fountain pen and mechanical pencil in a vibrant pearlescent red finish, accented with signature silver-tone hardware.
Branded "Esterbrook" visible on clips and barrel markings
Includes 1 lever-filler fountain pen, 1 matching mechanical pencil, original box, and literature
Classic red pearlescent "jewel tone" finish
Original presentation box included

The fountain pen lever shows resistance and the internal sac likely requires replacement for full utility. The original red presentation box shows shelf wear and minor structural damage to corners. Literature insert shows age-related yellowing.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production

The work features hand-blown glass cattails accented with gold-tone luster and delicate clear glass reeds, all emerging from a base crafted from natural burl wood and polished agate geode slices. description: This listing includes two vintage glass insulators used for telegraph or power lines. One is a clear glass Hemingray-42 insulator, manufactured by Hemingray, a well-known American glass company. The other is a blue-green glass insulator marked 'MADE IN U.S.A.' Both insulators have dome tops and internal threading for mounting on poles. Each piece features embossed lettering on the skirt area. These insulators are in used condition with no visible cracks or chips and only minor wear consistent with age. They are suitable for collectors of industrial and utility artifacts.

description:
Natural History Specimen
Four Polished Petrified Wood Slices
Fossilized Wood and Mineralized Silica
Approximately 16" x 12" x 11" (Lot Dimensions)
Unsigned
This collection of four polished petrified wood slices showcases the intricate process of permineralization, where organic wood fibers are replaced by minerals over millions of years while retaining the original cellular structure. Each specimen displays distinct annual growth rings and vibrant color variations ranging from deep onyx blacks to warm ochre and cream, typical of ancient coniferous or hardwood species. The faces have been polished to a high luster, revealing crystalline structures and unique geological signatures, while the perimeters retain the rugged, natural texture of fossilized bark.
Professionally polished faces highlighting internal mineral structures and growth patterns
Natural rough-hewn edges providing a stark contrast between raw earth and refined surface
Substantial total weight of 24 pounds suitable for architectural display or specimen collection
Condition:
Very good condition with stable mineral structures. As natural specimens, these pieces exhibit inherent fissures, inclusions, and voids characteristic of the fossilization process. Surfaces are polished to a high gloss with minimal abrasions and the specimens remain structurally sound.

description:
Natural Formation
Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens
Approx. 5.5" x 4" and 4" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This lot features two distinct geological specimens, showcasing the natural beauty of crystalline formations. The first is a classic hollow quartz geode with a textured dark matrix opening to reveal a cavity of sparkling white crystals. The second is an amethyst cluster specimen featuring light purple crystalline structures atop a layered agate and rock base. Together, these pieces provide a compelling study of mineral growth and make for excellent decorative display pieces or additions to a rock and mineral collection.
Total combined weight of 3.1 lbs as confirmed by digital scale measurement
One specimen features a distinct amethyst cluster with lavender-hued points and visible agate banding
Exterior bases include minor inventory markings in red and purple ink from previous cataloging
Largest specimen measures approximately 5.5 inches in length based on visual scale
Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.

While we respond as quickly & thoroughly as possible, please do not expect a response in less than 48 hours and we do not guarantee that we will be able to provide the information requested. Please take this into account when bidding.
We do not offer pick up at this time.
Items may contain unseen flaws/damage not noted in listing. Photos are part of the description. It is expected that buyers will do their own research as well and/or ask any questions prior to placing a bid. Do not bid if you are not confident in the information provided.
We DO NOT retract winning bids and will only retract bids prior to auction end if we are able during our normal business hours. RETRACTIONS ARE NOT GUARANTEED IN ANY INSTANCE. WE DO NOT REMOVE UNPAID ITEMS.
"Tested" indicates ONLY that the item has been powered on; no further testing or assessment of function has been done unless noted.
We do our best to accurately identify items but cannot guarantee complete or exact identification or function as we are not experts and we can only test items in a limited capacity.
We are not able to provide individual item details on multi item lots. BULK LOTS ARE NOT ELIGIBLE FOR RETURNS OR REFUNDS. It is likely they will contain tangled and broken items, as well as incomplete sets/pairs.
Measurements for items are approximated. While we do our best to provide sizes for single item lots, we cannot do so for multi item lots.
If sizes are not listed in the title or description, or shown in a photo, then we are unable to provide them
We do our best to show the true color/condition/etc of items in photos, but we are not expert photographers and items may appear different in person.
ALL ITEMS ARE SOLD AS IS.
*We offer combined shipping up to 20lbs shipping weight for most items for a significantly reduced shipping rate.
**WE DO NOT REMOVE, REDUCE, OR ALTER HANDLING FEES REGARDLESS OF THE NUMBER OF ITEMS PURCHASED. We DO NOT combine shipping after payment; all items must be combined at time of payment. If an item does not allow you to combine when paying it is because the item is not eligible.
Requests for combined shipping after payment WILL NOT be honored. We are sorry for any inconvenience.**
**Please retain ALL packaging (boxes, paper, etc) until you have confirmed your order is complete and correct. We will require photos of these items if a return or refund request is made, and your request will be denied if you are unable or unwilling to provide the required photos. Please see full return policy near bottom of disclaimer.**
*Orders over $100 may have signature confirmation at no expense to you to better protect your purchase. Please contact us PRIOR to shipment if you decline this service, with the understanding that we are not able to file claims or issue refunds for mis-delivered items if sig conf is declined. We are not able to remove signature conf or change shipping address after the item has left our location.
If a package is returned to us due to being undeliverable (e.g. non-pickup by recipient; unavailability of recipient; incorrect address entered by buyer; etc), we will issue a refund of the bid price only and the item will be relisted.
*"UNTESTED" indicates that the item's FUNCTION has not been tested in any way. It has not been turned on or had the function tested IN ANY WAY unless otherwise stated in the listing. This does not refer to any metal or gem testing.
*We describe gold and silver to the best of our ability. If there is not a test result on the listing or if "tested" is not explicitly stated in a precious metal listing, please assume the item was listed based on marking(s), magnet testing, & research.
Precious metal jewelry and other items may have resin, wax, or other cores; if we do not state this, it is because we do not know. We provide a total weight of the item, which is the weight of all components of the item, stated and unstated (unknown).
*Imperfections may be noted in writing or shown in photos.
*Total weight (TW) includes gems, stones, embellishments, other metals/materials, clasps, etc
*Gems are tested w/ Presidium Gem Tester II and/or SAM by Presidium: Diamond Tester & Moissanite Identifier. These do not differentiate between natural and lab-created gems. Gems may be natural or lab created, we are not experts in this or any other field and list gems based on the PGTII results.
*Watches, electronics, etc are Untested for function and are Sold As-Is, no returns
*Items may contain original or replacement parts.
*Props/rulers/scales/coins used to show scale are not included.
*Unless otherwise stated, please assume metals and gems are NOT precious or semi precious.
*Please note that any listings that include a metal analysis reading from our Niton™ DXL Precious Metal Analyzer will NOT be eligible for return on the basis of metal tests done by the buyer (e.g. acid tests, etc) unless they are done on the same or more advanced spectrometer, as this type of testing is highly accurate. Barring special circumstances, returns will only be considered in these instances if a reading on such a machine or a certificate can be provided from a licensed jeweler saying how the item is different than stated in the listing. If providing results from your own machine we will require photographic proof of the metal reading, proof of the type of analyzer, and proof of date of last calibration. We are not responsible for any costs incurred when getting the item tested. All questions regarding the accuracy, composition, authenticity or any other query must be asked PRIOR to placing any bids on the item*

: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.

description:
[Unmarked]
Brass-Tone Metal Double Inkwell Set
Victorian Style, Mid-20th Century or Earlier
This ornate desk set features a central gnome or elf figure with a long beard and pointed cap, situated between two lidded inkwells. The base is heavily decorated with scrolling foliate motifs and includes a built-in pen tray at the front. The set reflects the whimsical and highly decorative Aesthetic and Victorian movements, often incorporating mythological or folklore figures into functional household items. The set is accompanied by a horse-head letter opener and a small spoon with a bust-handle finial.
Cast metal construction with a brass-tone finish and natural aged patina
Set includes dual hinged-lid inkwells, one ceramic insert, horse-head letter opener, and bust-handle spoon
Detailed gnome figure casting and ornate scrollwork base
Approximate dimensions: 8" wide x 6" deep x 5.5" high
Condition:
Good vintage condition with natural oxidation and patina consistent with age. One inkwell is missing its interior liner; the other contains a white ceramic liner with visible ink staining. Hinges are intact and functional. Letter opener and spoon show minor surface wear. No structural breaks or repairs visible.

Description:
Discover a unique collector's item with this vintage boxed set of crystal rock specimens from Salzbergwerk Berchtesgaden, Germany. The set includes six individual crystal samples neatly housed in their original labeled compartments, each representing different types of salt and mineral stones. These include red, gray, white, yellow, and dark red rock salt varieties, along with an anhydrite gypsum piece as indicated by the German-language insert. The samples retain their natural crystalline texture and are presented in a charming retro box with detailed informational text and decorative artwork reflecting the rich mining heritage of the Berchtesgaden region. The box shows visible signs of age-related wear and some soiling, and the crystals display minor surface residue but remain in solid condition. Ideal for collectors of geological or mineral specimens, educational purposes, or display, this set provides a fascinating glimpse into mineral diversity and European mining history. Enhance your collection with this distinctive presentation from a renowned salt mining area

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points

Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.

Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.

Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Manufactured by the Whitall Tatum company, these insulators were used for telegraph and power lines during the early to mid-20th century. The glass ranges from clear to slightly smoky in color. Each insulator measures approximately 3-4 inches in height. The items are in good vintage condition with surface wear and dirt consistent with age and outdoor use. No major cracks or chips are visible. Each piece features embossed manufacturer details on the base.
